items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s a commercial fusion record. That’s an absolute fusion record.

ctx.x: This is a funny but interesting band: Randy Brecker, Barry Rogers, Dave Taylor, Tom Malone, you, Sato, Ryo Kawasaki, Francisco Santino on bass, and Harvey Mason on drums.
That’s a commercial fusion record. That’s an absolute fusion record.
Yeah. That’s what it looks like. Next is the first of three record you did with our friend John McNeil.
